Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement here at Acme Health has two outstanding items before we can finish the Ariba registration: 

1) Order-form exceptions — our finance team needs clarity on PO acknowledgement timing and whether Redwood can accept a delayed PO-ack window for EDI partners. We have a few SKU/line-level requirements that normally live in order-form addenda and need to know if those can be captured in your order form or if they require an MSA amendment.

2) Identity mapping — our Ariba connector needs a canonical "vendor identity" field (taxID + site id) that must be accepted by the order form without manual redlines. Legal flagged potential conflict with your existing MSA identity language (section 3.2).

Can you share a playbook or sample language we can present to our legal and EDI teams? Also, is there a recommended way to attach PO mapping metadata to the Ariba registration so it flows into PO acknowledgements?

Appreciate your help — Maria

Maria —

Thanks for the clear summary. I pulled together a short playbook (attached) that outlines how we handle: order-form exceptions, recommended identity-mapping fields for Ariba, and the trade-offs between embedding requirements in the order form vs MSA addenda. High-level:

- We prefer to keep field-level PO requirements in an "Order Form Addendum" when they are buyer-specific (SKU-level tolerances, delivery SLAs).
- For identity mapping, the canonical vendor identity (taxID + siteID) can be surfaced as a required field in the Ariba registration. We typically add a short MSA clause that says the order form's identity mapping controls for EDI ingestion.
- PO-ack timing exceptions: we can accept a 48-hour acknowledgement SLA for partners using our EDI bridge, but that needs a defined acceptance/escape hatch in the order form so finance can reconcile.

Attached: orderform-exception-playbook-v1.docx — it's a working draft with suggested redline language. Also linking the Ariba workspace for your EDI team: https://ariba.acmehealth.com/workspace/activation/ACME-REDWOOD-4721

Next steps I propose:
- Laura (legal) to review the suggested MSA clause for identity mapping and PO-ack exceptions.
- If Laura is OK, we can provide editable redlines back to you and your counsel for a fast turn.

Marissa, marking you on this for commercial terms if Acme wants a custom order-form addendum.

Best,
Avery

Hi Maria / Acme team —

Thanks for the detailed note and the playbook, Avery. I've attached a redline of the MSA with our recommended language (redlined-msa-identity-mapping.pdf) and a clean order-form template showing where buyer-specific PO-field requirements should live (orderform-signed-template.docx). Summary of our positions: 

1) Identity mapping: Acceptable. We will add a narrow clause to Section 3.2 that authorizes the order form to define the canonical identity for EDI ingestion (taxID + siteID). Language is limited to vendor identity used for PO processing only; it does not broaden data sharing or additional personal data use.

Suggested snippet (redline): "For the purposes of purchase order processing and EDI ingestion, the Order Form may designate the canonical vendor identity (e.g., tax identification number and site identifier). Such designation shall exclusively govern order routing and acknowledgement processing and shall not constitute authorization for additional uses of vendor personal data."

2) PO acknowledgements: We can accommodate a 48-hour acknowledgement SLA for partners using Redwood's EDI bridge, provided: 
- The Order Form includes an explicit acceptance criteria and an exception flow for disputed line items.
- Finance will not be liable for downstream chargebacks arising from late acknowledgement unless Redwood fails to meet the agreed EDI throughput SLA.

3) Data/privacy: We limited the identity-mapping language to avoid referencing any personal identifiers (no DOB, SSN, etc.). If Acme requires additional PII fields for internal validation, that must be handled via a separate data processing addendum.

Next steps:
- Please review the attached redline; if acceptable, sign the order-form template and we will generate a final Order Form Addendum for your EDI configuration.
- If Acme counsel asks for any further carve-outs, please send their redlines to me directly and we will respond with line-by-line commentary.

I'll also attach the PDF redline here for visibility.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
